title: Kuandika kwa Tarakilishi (Theme 3: Mapambo)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 5 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child names each part used for typing and printing and says its job, including the special keys.

floor.prerequisite: Names the keyboard, mouse and screen.
floor.question: Tunaandikia kwa nini?

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child labels six parts and matches each to its job.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Sehemu ya kupigia herufi ni ipi?" Kwa nini "kipanya" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kibodi ina vitufe vya herufi vya kupigia chapa. Kipanya hutumika kusogeza kielekezi, na skrini huonyesha kilichoandikwa.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Kichapishi hufanya nini?" Kwa nini "Huonyesha maandishi" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kichapishi huchapisha kwenye karatasi. Skrini ndiyo huonyesha maandishi.
Shift huandika herufi kubwa; Enter huanzisha mstari mpya.
Skrini huonyesha kazi; kichapishi huitoa kwenye karatasi.

skills.key_step: The child places the cursor at the mistake, fixes only that, formats by selecting first, and saves in his own folder with a clear name.

floor.prerequisite: Types a sentence and saves it.
floor.question: Ni kitufe kipi huanzisha mstari mpya?

representations: a sample text with three mistakes
the Save window on the board
steps: Save in your folder with a clear name.

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child fixes the word, makes the title bold and saves the file.

listen_for: futa sentensi yote na uanze upya
misconceptions.repair: Weka kishale mahali pa kosa na ufute herufi hiyo tu.
Chagua folda yako na uandike jina linaloeleza kazi.
Chagua neno kwanza, kisha bonyeza B.

misconceptions.ask: Nafasi iko kabla au baada ya koma?
misconceptions.repair: Alama hukaa karibu na neno lililotangulia; nafasi hufuata alama.

checks.question: Kitufe kipi hufuta herufi kabla ya kishale?
Unafanya nini kwanza kabla ya kubonyeza B?
